meta_description: STM Plumbing is your trusted emergency plumber in Bolton. Fast response, honest pricing, and expert repairs. Call now for same-day service.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe at 3am? We're here. Emergency plumbing in Bolton with fast callouts and honest upfront pricing.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing Services Across Bolton and Greater Manchester
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to planned installations, we handle all your plumbing needs with speed and professionalism.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We attend emergencies 24/7 and carry parts on the van to get the job done same day.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Repair
services.desc: New boiler installations with 10-year warranties, plus emergency repairs to keep your heating running. Gas Safe certified throughout.

services.title: Central Heating
services.desc: System upgrades, radiator installation, and power flushing to improve efficiency and cut your heating bills.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Installation
services.desc: Full bathroom redesigns and kitchen plumbing from concept to completion. We work with your timeline and budget.

services.title: Drain Clearance & Repair
services.desc: Blocked drains cleared fast with CCTV inspection to diagnose root causes. We fix the problem, not just the symptom.

services.title: Maintenance & Servicing
services.desc: Annual boiler servicing and planned maintenance visits prevent costly breakdowns and keep warranties valid.

about_pullquote: We show up on time, fix it right, and charge what we quote. That's it.
about_para_1: STM Plumbing has been serving Bolton and the surrounding areas for over 12 years. Started by a local plumber fed up with cowboys overcharging neighbours, we've built our reputation on honest pricing, rapid response, and workmanship that lasts. Every engineer is Gas Safe registered and trained to the highest standards.
about_para_2: We answer our phone — not an automated queue. Our customers call us back because we turn up when we say, diagnose the real problem, and fix it without unnecessary extras. Whether it's 2pm on a Tuesday or 2am on a Sunday, you get the same professional service and fair pricing.
reviews_heading: What Bolton Homeowners Say About STM Plumbing

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe on a Sunday morning — phoned STM and someone was here within 45 minutes. Fixed it properly, not a temporary patch. Fair quote, no hidden charges. Brilliant service, will use again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: New boiler installation last month. The lads were professional, tidy, and finished on time. Explained everything clearly and the paperwork was all sorted. 10-year warranty gives me real peace of mind.
reviews.author: Sandra K.

reviews.text: Called for an emergency blockage on a Friday night. They got someone out same evening, cleared it properly with CCTV inspection, and showed me what the problem was. No panic, no overcharging. Exactly what you want from a plumber.
reviews.author: David R.
